notes.title: Patch - May 2022
notes.notes:
Two small bugs have been reported and fixed in this update.
Bug 1 - constant adding of same journal entry when talking to the kids in the street
Bug 2 - semi-crash when trying to give items to guards in Letize

While neither of these two bugs was serious, we wanted to ensure a smoother experience for you.

notes.title: Bug fix October 26th
notes.notes:
Some more minor bugs were fixed. No major impact on the game but, again, to ensure a smoother experience.

Journal entry appearing too late with Maurice and Lionel - fixed
Librarian not always ready to discuss your book needs - fixed

notes.title: Patch 1, October 22 2021
notes.notes:
A minor bug has been detected and reported by one player. Had no influence on the game itself but we've fixed it to make for a smoother experience.

Bug - during conversation with Kimley, the same journal entry could get added multiple times - FIXED

notes.title: Release date for Trouble Hunter Chronicles
notes.notes:
The game is finally finished!

It's been tested and stress tested so we hope you'll have a bug free experience but enough is enough and we've set a release date - next weekend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310736/1f55fba86a08299a003347ca5fcc372008947647.jpg[/img]

Sunday, October 17th. PC version, both for Windows and Linux, will be available right here on Steam! The steam version features achievements designed to make the adventure game even more challenging!

If you're interested in a MAC version you'll need to check our [url=http://troublehunterchronicles.com]website[/url] on the release day for more information.

Make sure to pack your equipment, sharpen your puzzle solving skills and get ready for some trouble hunting next weekend!

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
After several months of hard work we've finally caught up with all the artwork in the game! Most of it is finished and a lot of the existing artwork has been updated from the first versions.

We're close to having Trouble Hunter Chronicles released and are now working on cutscenes (yes, just like in good old adventure games of yore we'll have some cutscenes), finishing the few remaining pieces of artwork and testing the game!

Not ready to set a date in stone yet but it should definitely be this fall.
We're also adding a few last minute surprises to the game which we hope you'll like! Stay tunes and, if you haven't yet, wishlist the game!

notes.title: Progress update!
notes.notes:
We're working on Trouble Hunter Chronicles and have recently inserted a new NPC into the game. You can see how we test the background animation and interaction in the clip.

We'll keep you posted on the exact release date.

notes.title: Game manual added
notes.notes:
Once upon a time all games came with a booklet which was cradled, loved and called the Game Manual! This was a work of art in itself, colored pages, great images, lots of flavor text and, of course, some details about installing, playing and troubleshooting the game.

These days games may have manuals but, let's be honest, it's rare that anyone even checks them out. That's okay. It's a different time. But as our game is inspired by the old school style games we created a game manual for Trouble Hunter Chronicles.

It's not a work of art, it's not filled with beautiful images and it is in digital format so you can't cradle it, take it to school and read it during math class! It can, however, help you out if you're a complete newbie when it comes to point and click adventure games as it explains the controls for the game quite well.

We [i]might[/i] improve it graphically in the future but no promises!

There is, however, a bit of flavor text so you can know you're actually reading a game manual :D

It should be available from our Steam page, from your steam client and, to help you out, right here on [url=https://troublehunterchronicles.com/TroubleHunterChronicles_TheStolenCreed_Manual.pdf]THIS LINK[/url].

notes.title: Who is the main character?
notes.notes:
Trouble Hunter Chronicles: The Stolen Creed puts you in control of Thomas Connor, an ex OSS operative. Thomas stayed in France after the end of World War 2 and looked forward to a chance at normal, civilian life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310736/296b53b5e2c315e7b8dfa1080f309c8896237701.jpg[/img]

Using his language skills, developed during the war, Thomas found work as translator and interpreter. However, Thomas was not cut out for civilian life. Lacking a daily dose of excitement, his thoughts turned gloomy and his treacherous mind played back all friends, lost during the war.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310736/54c472ee8d7d0f792762e59d62dfdbdc4da148f1.jpg[/img]

Unable to cope with boredom, dark thoughts and civilian pressures like rent, Thomas turned to drink.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310736/e8288e9189a1ebc18ac8b744046414bb59c763dd.jpg[/img]

With his less than pleasant attitude his work started dwindling and this is where we find Thomas - in a small French town of Verrix, drinking at the local bar or sleeping off his drunken stupor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310736/c570f7133a3d65fbccd75dc3fb29ea9254867d93.png[/img]

Is there a chance for Thomas yet? Even more important, is there a chance for the world? Because, as unlikely as it may seem, Thomas may very well be the only one with a shot at discovering the trouble the world is in for...

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355360/

notes.title: Trouble Hunter Chronicles Alpha goes live
notes.notes:
This weekend Trouble Hunter Chronicles: The Stolen Creed launches closed alpha testing!

We got a lot of applications from the interested community and the chosen applicants will be receiving their steam keys over the weekend. Alpha testing is here to rough test the game functionality on a variety of user systems, hunt for bugs and get a general feedback on game usability.

While we are sure the alpha testers are happy to be the first testing out the game, enjoying the scenes, dialogues and music, not a lot of actual game content will be revealed so don't feel like you're missing out!

Stay tuned to our social accounts (we suggest [url=https://discord.gg/tu7ChUy]discord[/url]) and wishlist the game as we have more pre-launch events and surprises in store!

notes.title: Taking alpha tester applications
notes.notes:
The game functions and framework have been finalised. It is now time to put them to the test so we can find any bugs we may have missed, and problems which crop up and to gather valuable feedback from the community on what you like and what you're not too crazy about!

[previewyoutube=pQjSv43XFSs;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have a PC with either Windows or Linux you can play Trouble Hunter Chronicles alpha.

Love of adventure games and some experience with games in general is desired but there are no specific requirements for you to be accepted so head to our [url=https://discord.gg/MRxSrzc]DISCORD SERVER[/url] and use the application form.

Stay tuned for more news about Trouble Hunter Chronicles!

notes.title: Progress continues on Trouble Hunter Chronicles
notes.notes:
Most landmarks of Verrix - the city where the majority of Trouble Hunter Chronicles takes place - have been created! Our original soundtrack is also keeping pace to switch mood depending on your current in-game location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310736/1d8fff95e3bc331e8ba8327ee209505163398b62.jpg[/img]

Our plan is to make more progress through the month of August and then start a small alpha testing phase! We'll be recruiting testers and taking applications on our [url=https://discord.gg/MRxSrzc]discord server[/url] so make sure to be there and voice your interest!
